answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 156395 Country: India Title: If I am doubtful about that my wet or dry hand touches to lizard's stool (white part of lizard's stool) during the fardh namaz with jamat. Will my hand become najis or not? Question: If I am doubtful about that my wet or dry hand touches to lizard's stool (white part of lizard's stool) during the fardh namaz with jamat. Will my hand become najis or not? Answer ID: 156395 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 231/173/N=3/1439) In the above mentioned case, your salah will be valid, you need not worry. If the dropping of the lizard was dry and so was your hand and you pulled your hand as soon as it touched the dropping or it was the dropping of a small lizard which usually lives on the walls and ceiling of the house then your hand did not turn impure. In the first case, no impurity touched in your hand and in the second case the dropping of the lizard is not impure. And in case it was the dropping of big lizard which has running blood and they usually live in forests then since the dropping touched your hand might have been nominal i.e. less than the quantity of one coin which is probable; hence in such case also your salah became valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
